reference: No matching GNU DHCPv6 CLI is documented for this loadable. Contract expectations use RFC 8415 wire formats: DUID-LL (type 3, hardware type 1), DHCPv6 message headers, big-endian option codes and lengths, CLIENTID/SERVERID, ELAPSED_TIME, IA_NA/IAADDR, ORO, and relay-message/interface-id options. The parse fixture is a hand-authored packet decoded independently from its TLVs; relay expectations are independently serialized from the same fixed address and payload values. Help strings are checked against the pinned builtin documentation. No expected value was taken from candidate output.
coverage: Bash builtin type/help metadata and documented version string
DUID-LL serialization for a fixed Ethernet MAC
SOLICIT construction with explicit transaction ID and default IAID
REQUEST construction with server DUID, IAADDR lifetimes, IAID, and ORO
ADVERTISE parsing of DUIDs, IA_NA/IAADDR, DNS, status, and ORO
RELAY-FORW wrapping and independent relay unwrapping
exclusions: There is no matching GNU DHCPv6 CLI, so these are contract checks rather than claimed GNU parity comparisons.
Live solicit and inforequest exchanges are deferred because they require an isolated disposable network with a controlled DHCPv6 server and packet capture.
RECONFIGURE HMAC verification and less common parser fields such as IA_PD/IAPREFIX are not covered by this compact suite.

cases.purpose: Check Bash reports dhcp6 as a builtin, its registered help contains the documented builder/parser and relay forms, and --version prints the pinned documented version string.
cases.script:
type -t dhcp6
doc=$(help dhcp6)
[[ $doc == *"DHCPv6 (RFC 8415) client message builder + parser."* ]]
[[ $doc == *"dhcp6 build TYPE -d CLIENT_DUID"* ]]
[[ $doc == *"dhcp6 relay-unwrap RELAY_HEX"* ]]
dhcp6 --version
cases.stdout:
builtin
dhcp6 (bash-os F03 DHCPv6) RFC 8415 client message core

cases.purpose: Check DUID-LL encodes the RFC type 3 and Ethernet hardware type 1 before the six supplied MAC octets.
Check deterministic SOLICIT wire bytes: message type 1, XID 0x123456, CLIENTID, zero ELAPSED_TIME, and default IA_NA IAID 1 with zero T1/T2.
Check REQUEST serialization with both DUID options, explicit transaction ID and IAID, an IAADDR for 2001:db8::1 with 3600/7200-second lifetimes, and ORO codes 23 and 24.
Check INFORMATION-REQUEST uses message type 11, includes CLIENTID, ELAPSED_TIME, and the selected ORO, and omits IA_NA as required for a stateless request.

Decode a fixed ADVERTISE packet independently encoded with client/server DUIDs, IA_NA containing IAADDR, two DNS servers, Success status text, and an ORO; check field names, ordering, numeric decoding, and IPv6 text formatting.
cases.stdout:
msg_type=ADVERTISE
xid=0xa1b2c3
client_id=00030001020000000099
server_id=00030001aabbccddeeff
iaid=16909060
t1=0
t2=0
address=2001:db8::1
preferred=600
valid=1200
dns=2001:4860:4860::8888,2001:4860:4860::8844
status=0
status_msg=ok
oro=23,24

cases.purpose: Check parse -V binds documented message fields into a Bash associative array without emitting key=value lines to stdout.
cases.script:
declare -A parsed=()
dhcp6 parse 02010203 -V parsed
printf '%s|%s\n' "${parsed[msg_type]}" "${parsed[xid]}"

cases.purpose: Reject an otherwise valid four-byte message header whose CLIENTID option declares four data bytes but supplies only two.
Check independent RFC relay serialization: RELAY-FORW type 12, hop count, fixed link/peer IPv6 addresses, OPTION_RELAY_MSG with the inner message, and OPTION_INTERFACE_ID containing lan0.
Decode a fixed independently encoded RELAY-FORW packet and check hop, link/peer addresses, interface identifier, and inner message hex.
cases.stdout:
type=RELAY-FORW
hop=2
link=2001:db8::1
peer=fe80::2
interface_id=lan0
inner=01010203

cases.purpose: Exercise the live SOLICIT to ADVERTISE to REQUEST to REPLY state machine only in a future disposable network fixture.
cases.reason: The live state machine is reachable on [::1] with -S ::1 and BASHDHCP6_* ports; no DHCPv6 peer exists.

cases.purpose: Exercise the live stateless INFORMATION-REQUEST exchange and DNS/domain option handling only in a future disposable network fixture.
cases.reason: The live exchange is reachable on IPv6 loopback with -S ::1 and BASHDHCP6_SERVER_PORT/CLIENT_PORT; the peer driver lacks a DHCPv6/IPv6 peer.

cases.purpose: Malformed DUID syntax returns documented usage status without packet activity.
